ability.name: Stellar Slash
ability.description: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%), then deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage to the current target. N.O.V.A. Strike: Cleave the battlefield, briefly knocking up all enemies and dealing @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage.

ability.name: Fish Frenzy
ability.description: Passive: For every @PercentMissingHealth@% missing Health, gain @ModifiedAS@% (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target, increased by @PercentBonusDamage*100@% if they're a tank.

ability.name: Aim For The Head
ability.description: Passive: Attacks have a @ProcChance@% Lucky chance to fire an empowered Headshot, dealing @ModifiedHeadshotDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. N.O.V.A. Strike: Mark all enemies, increasing damage taken by @NovaMarkDamageAmp*100@%. The first time marked targets drop below @NovaMarkThreshold*100@% Health, Headshot them for @ModifiedNovaHeadshotDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Accretion
ability.description: Deal @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the lowest Health enemy in range and permanently gain @BonusHealthPerCast@ maximum Health. If this kills them, permanently gain @BonusHealthOnKill@ maximum Health instead. (Current Bonus: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_ChoGathBonusHealth@ Health)

ability.name: Temporal Shot
ability.description: Active: Fire a blast at the current target that deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Every @TakedownsToDrone@ takedowns, gain a drone that deals @ModifiedDroneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the current target on cast. (Total Takedowns: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Ezreal_Takedowns@)

ability.name: Shield of Daybreak
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Bash the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Dark Matter
ability.description: Hurl a shard towards the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the first target it hits. After hitting its initial target or at its final destination, the dagger explodes dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to nearby targets.

ability.name: Groovin' Susan
ability.description: Transform for @Duration@ seconds, temporarily gaining @MaxHealth@ max Health, entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}, and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies each second.

ability.name: Huddle Up!
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. For the duration, allies within two hexes gain @ModifiedResists@ (%i:scaleAP%) Armor and Magic Resistance. Meep Bonus: Meeps grant @ModifiedMeepShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield to the nearest @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) allies for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Upheaval
ability.description: Heal @TotalHealing@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%), then briefly knock up adjacent enemies and deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Diviner's Judgment
ability.description: Stab the target, causing them to bleed for @ModifiedBleedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. After the attack, leap to the highest percent Health enemy within @HexDistance@ hexes.

ability.name: Double Time
ability.description: Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedHitDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage and an additional @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) stacking magic damage over @PoisonDuration@ seconds. While an enemy has @GrooveStacks@ or more stacks, Teemo is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}. Active: Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveAttacks@ attacks.

ability.name: Fate's Gambit
ability.description: Draw a card with a value between 1 and 9 by Lucky chance, then throw it at the target. Based on the card drawn, deal between @ModifiedDamageMin@ (%i:scaleAP%) and @ModifiedDamageMax@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Overkill damage bounces to the nearest enemy. 3-Star Bonus: If a 9 is thrown, generate 1 gold. Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Meepteor Shower
ability.description: Call down a Meepteor on the target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Meep Bonus: An additional @ModifiedMiniMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) mini Meepteor are called down on nearby targets dealing @ModifiedMiniDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each.

ability.name: Star Strike
ability.description: Reposition next to the target to strike the most enemies. Then throw @NumShurikens@ piercing kunai, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the first enemy hit, reduced to @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) for each subsequent target. Kunai remove @ArmorShred@ Armor, @ArmorShredCrit@ if they crit. N.O.V.A. Strike: Slice all enemies, applying Wound and a bleed that deals @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each second. Kunai increase the damage of the bleed by @NovaShurikenBonusDamage*100@%.

ability.name: Tidal Slashes
ability.description: Unleash a flurry of @TotalNumSlashes@ (%i:scaleAS%) slashes at the current target over @SlashDuration@ seconds, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage each.

ability.name: Slingshot Maneuver
ability.description: Passive: Every 5th attack, launch a returning boomerang at the target that travels two hexes past the first enemy it hits. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit*100@% per hit. Meep Bonus: @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meeps attack alongside Gnar, dealing @ModifiedMeepDPS@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAS%) physical damage per second.

ability.name: Chemical Rage
ability.description: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) over @Duration@ seconds. Then, deal @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to target and enemies adjacent to them and @ASSlow*100@% Chill them for @CCDuration@ seconds. {{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}

ability.name: Dance n' Dice
ability.description: Passive: Attacks deal magic damage. Gwen is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} while targeting an enemy below @GrooveThreshold*100@% Health. Active: Dash to a nearby hex to snip the lowest percent Health enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target and @ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies in a cone. If this kills, dash and snip again at @ResetDamage*100@% damage!

ability.name: Counter Star-ike
ability.description: Enter a defensive stance for @Duration@ seconds, reducing incoming damage by @ModifiedFlatDR@ and gaining @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield. When the stance ends, strike all nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ second(s).

ability.name: Explosive Attitude
ability.description: Fire a barrage of @ModifiedNumRockets@ (%i:scaleAS%) rockets in a cone, each dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the first target hit.

ability.name: Meep Impact
ability.description: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Health over @HealDuration@ seconds. Slam the target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and knocking up for @StunDuration@ seconds. The impact creates meepwaves that deal @PercentEffects*100@% of these effects in the target's row. Meep Bonus: Meeps water Meepsie's flower, increasing all incoming Healing and Shielding by @ModifiedHealingAndShielding@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%).

ability.name: Mega Time Kick
ability.description: Kick a ball at the current target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. On impact, the ball has a 100% Lucky chance to bounce to a new target dealing @ModifiedBounceDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. These bounces can trigger additional bounces, but the odds halve with each bounce. Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Indestructible
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedInitialShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield. Each second for the next @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedShieldPerProc@ (%i:scaleAP%) more Shield and deal @ModifiedDamagePerProc@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies. When this ability ends, consume the remaining Shield and heal for @HealRefund*100@% of its value.

ability.name: Advanced Defences
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Shield and @Durability*100@% Durability for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each second to enemies in a cone.

ability.name: Marked for Death
ability.description: Reposition up to one hex to throw a harpoon at the furthest enemy. The harpoon pulls the first enemy hit one hex forward and deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Then, teleport behind them and cleave, dealing @ModifiedTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to them and @ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to nearby enemies.

ability.name: Paddle Star
ability.description: Fire a paddle star at the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the first target hit and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to others it passes through. When the missile reaches its destination, redirect it to a distant enemy, increasing its speed and repeating the damage. This redirect can occur @AugmentedNumRedirects@@NumRedirects@ times.

ability.name: Hopped-Up Hacks
ability.description: Open a @SpellHexRadius@ hex rift containing the target, Hacking enemies within for @HexDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each, plus @ModifiedSplitDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies hit. Hacked enemies store @HexPercent*100@% of all damage they take. When the Hack ends, they take true damage equal to the stored damage. The Hack ends early if it would kill the target.

ability.name: Meep Bait
ability.description: Dash through the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Every third cast also summons a Mega Meep after a delay, briefly knocking the target up and dealing @ModifiedChompDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:set14AmpIcon%) magic damage. Adjacent enemies take @SecondaryDamage*100@% damage. Meep Bonus: Add @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meep to the bait, increasing Mega Meep damage by @ModifiedMeepBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).

ability.name: Test of Spirit
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, drain @ModifiedHealthDrain@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health from the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Then slam down, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes.

ability.name: Bullet Cluster
ability.description: Passive: On takedown, gain @ManaPerKill@ mana. Active: Fire @BaseNumMissiles@ missiles in a @HexRange@-hex radius around the current target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each.

ability.name: It's Raining Stars
ability.description: Passive: Gain a different secondary effect each game based on the Stargazer constellation. Active: Call down something from the sky, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to @NumEnemies@ nearby enemies and do some special effect based on this game's Stargazer Constellation.

ability.name: Grasp of Convergence
ability.description: Passive: Gain @PassiveRatio*100@% more max Health from all sources. Active: Converge an X-shape of vines on the target, dealing @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each enemy hit and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. N.O.V.A. Strike: Send forth a wave of dragons that stun all enemies for @NovaStunDuration@ seconds. For the rest of combat, Maokai's attacks deal @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%) bonus physical damage.

ability.name: Gun Goddess Arsenal
ability.description: Field Miss Fortune to choose whether she activates Conduit Mode, Challenger Mode, or Replicator Mode. The chosen mode determines her ability and her trait.

ability.name: Disco Inferno
ability.description: Passive: On combat start, forge a temporary completed item. If 3 items are already equipped, a random completed item becomes Radiant this combat instead. Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, then breath fire in a cone dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. After any Shield on Ornn expires, Ornn enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Divine Scythe
ability.description: Gain @Durability*100@% Durability for @Duration@ seconds, healing @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) over the duration. Afterwards, slash forward in a line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for @KnockupDuration@ second.

ability.name: Jump and Jive
ability.description: Passive: Whenever an enemy is knocked up, shoot them, dealing @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds. Active: Unleash a volley of bullets at the target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and knocking up for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Unstoppable Dreadnought
ability.description: Passive - Proximity Blast: Whenever an enemy enters a @ShotgunRange@ (%i:scaleRange%) hex radius, fire a blast in a cone towards the closest adjacent hex that deals @ModifiedShotgunDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage with @FalloffPerHex*100@% falloff per hex. Each adjacent hex has a @ShotgunCooldown@ second cooldown, and starts combat on cooldown. Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and reposition up to one hex to maximize the number of targets within Proximity Blast's radius. Reset Proximity Blast's cooldowns.

ability.name: Psionic Storm
ability.description: Channel a one-hex psionic storm that follows enemies for @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. Each second, it grows larger and deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within, reduced by @FalloffPerHex*100@% per hex from the epicenter.

ability.name: Deathbeam
ability.description: Channel a deathbeam in a line towards the current target for @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second, reduced by @DamageReductionPerTarget*100@% per enemy it passes through. Deathbeam ignores @MagicPen*100@% of the enemy's Magic Resist.

ability.name: Asteroid Blaster
ability.description: Strafe to a nearby position, unleashing @BaseMissiles@ missiles split between the target and all enemies within two hexes. Missiles deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage with a @ProcChance@% Lucky chance of firing a mega missile that deals @ModifiedProcDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) instead. Meep Bonus: Every @ModifiedMeepCooldown@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) seconds, launch an Explosive Meep at the target, dealing @ModifiedMeepDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage in a one hex radius on impact. Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

ability.name: Singularity
ability.description: Gather the force of a black hole, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between the target and the @NumEnemies@ closest enemies to them. The target takes an additional @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Cosmic Pursuit
ability.description: Passive: Attacks and Abilities mark the target. When an enemy reaches @MaxMarks@ marks, Wolf consumes the marks, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Active: Jump up to @HexDistance@ hex away and fire arrows at the nearest @NumTargets@ targets, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. N.O.V.A. Strike: Gain @NovaDamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp. Now and every @NovaRepeatTimer@ seconds after, add a mark to all enemies.

ability.name: Fracture Reality
ability.description: Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedBaseAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead. Active: Summon @NumClones@ clones that attack alongside for @NumAttacks@ attacks, dealing @CloneDamageMultiplier*100@% damage. For their final attack, clones fire a bolt that deals @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

ability.name: Psi Strikes
ability.description: Passive: Every third attack is a doubleslash that deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage. Active: After brief meditation, enter a Psi-State for @Duration@ seconds, gaining @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed, and increased movement speed. Twice a second, fire a psychic projection at a random nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage

ability.name: Dark Form
ability.description: Transform for @HealthGainDuration@ seconds, gaining @ModifiedHealthGain@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%) Health and tethering to nearby champions. Over the duration, deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the closest @NumEnemies@ enemies and restore @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) health to the closest @NumAllies@ injured allies.

ability.name: Bubble Pop
ability.description: Toss a disco bubble at the target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) split between enemies in a one hex radius. The explosion sends @NumProjectiles@ globs towards nearby enemies that deal @ModifiedFirstBounceDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. On cast, Nami enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Calamity
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Summon an astrolabe to crash down on a nearby hex, dealing @ModifiedInitialDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes. Then, push the astrolabe towards the end of the board, dealing @ModifiedFollowupDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. All enemies hit by the astrolabe are knocked up for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Gravitational Spin
ability.description: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then, strike enemies in a three hex line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%) magic damage. Meep Bonus: Reduce the damage of incoming attacks by @ModifiedFlatDR@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%). After being attacked @AttacksPerPassiveTrigger@ times, deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:set14AmpIcon%) magic damage in a two hex radius.

ability.name: Time Warp
ability.description: Passive: This Ability adapts to Attack Damage or Ability Power, whichever is higher. Attacks deal @ModifiedPassiveAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedPassiveADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Active: Dash to a nearby hex, gaining @Shield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and slashing adjacent enemies for @ModifiedAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Every third cast, leap into the air and launch a wave of energy that deals @ModifiedAPWaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedADWaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a line.

ability.name: Tounge Lash
ability.description: Passive: Once per combat after dropping below @HPThreshold*100@% Health, gain Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds equal to @PercentHealingToShield*100@% of healing received this combat. Active: Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%), then tongue lash all enemies within two hexes dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%) magic damage.

ability.name: Gravity Matrix
ability.description: Enter a defensive stance for @DurabilityDuration@ seconds gaining @Durability*100@% Durability. While in the defensive stance, attract nearby enemy projectiles and heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) over the duration. When this ends, release a shockwave that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) as physical damage in a @HexRange@-hex range.

ability.name: Stellar Ricochet
ability.description: Passive: Attacks bounce to strike @AttackNumEnemies@ times, dealing @PassivePercentReducedDamage*100@% reduced damage per target hit and leaving a Feather behind the final target. Active: Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. At the end, recall all Feathers split between the closest @RecallFeatherTargets@ enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each. Xayah's current target takes @ModifiedPrimaryTargetBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) additional physical damage per feather.

ability.name: Ultra Friendly Object
ability.description: Summon a flying saucer over the current target that lasts @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. Each second it deals @ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target, plus @ModifiedSplitDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies within @SecondaryHexRange@ hex. The saucer deals @TankDamageIncrease*100@% increased damage to Tanks. If an enemy under the UFO dies, Bard has a @AbductChance*100@% chance to abduct them and create a 1-star copy on your bench. Meep bonus: On combat start, grant the nearest @ModifiedNumAllies@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meeple allies an additional Meep. Friends abducted: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Bard_FriendsAbducted@

ability.name: Party Crasher
ability.description: Passive: Every @BoltCooldown@ seconds, call down a bolt on the highest Health nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Active: Summon a disco ball at the largest clump of enemies, then knock up the current target into it, dealing @ModifiedUppercutDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. They crash down into the disco ball, dealing @ModifiedExplosionDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a three hex radius. Enter {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDurationPerTarget@ second per enemy hit.

ability.name: Perfect Bladework
ability.description: Passive: Every @NumAttacks@ attacks, reveal a Vital on the target. If a Vital exists, dash to attack it dealing @ModifiedVitalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus true damage and heal for @PercentHealing*100@% of the damage dealt. Active: Reveal @NumVitals@ Vitals on the target and quickly attack them all. If the target dies, remaining Vitals transfer to the nearest enemy. Upon striking the final Vital, create a two hex aura that heals allies within for @ModifiedHealing@ (%i:scaleAP%) over @AuraDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Collateral Damage
ability.description: Passive: Attacks fire @NumProjectiles@ projectiles in a cone that deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:TFTBaseAD%) physical damage each. Active: Fire an explosive shell that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target, and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Space Opera
ability.description: Passive: Jhin has a fixed attack speed of @FixedAS@ and converts every @PercentBonusASToConvert*100@% of bonus Attack Speed into @ADConversionRate@ bonus Attack Damage. Active: Summon @NumHands@ spectral hands that fire alongside Jhin for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. Each hand deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage per shot. The final shots deal @FinalShotPercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage and pierce through the most enemies in a line, dealing @PercentDamageReductionPerTargetHit*100@% reduced damage per target hit.

ability.name: Reality Tear
ability.description: Passive: On cast, attacks gain @ModifiedBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) stacking bonus magic damage. Starting from the third cast, gain true damage instead. Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, then slice open a rift on the largest group of champions dealing the Passive's bonus damage to all enemies within. Enemies have their Attack Speed slowed by @ASSlow*100@% while allies within gain @BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed, both rapidly decaying over @BuffDebuffDuration@ seconds. Shen always gains his rift's full bonus for this duration.

ability.name: Psionic Crush
ability.description: Hurl a chunk of magnetic debris at the nearest target without one, dealing @ModifiedDebrisDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and sticking it to them. If an enemy with debris dies, it passes to the nearest enemy without one. Every @NumCasts@ casts, instead rip off all debris dealing @ModifiedDebrisRipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, then crush all the debris onto the target, dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and briefly stunning them.

ability.name: Lend Me a Hand, Shadow!
ability.description: Passive: Every time Vex attacks, Shadow strikes a nearby enemy, dealing @ModifiedShadowHandDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Whenever an enemy is struck @NumStrikesForPassive@ times by Shadow, Shadow strikes them again. Active: Shadow launches @NumActiveStrikes@ empowered strikes, dealing @ModifiedShadowHandMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

ability.name: Quantum Clone
ability.description: Create a clone behind the target with @HPPenalty*100@% reduced max Health and @ManaCostIncrease@ increased Mana cost. The clone inherits its creator's items, stats, and current Health, and can cast Quantum Clone.

traits.name: Anima
traits.description: After losing a player combat, gain @TechPerCombat@ Tech, plus additional Tech equal to @TechPerLoss@ times the length of your loss streak. Additionally, gain @TechPerKill@ Tech per Anima takedown. Each time Animas get @TechBreakpoint@ Tech, they prototype new Anima Weapons. You can take them, or save your Tech to get more powerful weapons next time. (@MinUnits@) Start Researching! (@MinUnits@) After each player combat, gain loot! Gain @PairsPartnerWinMultiplier*100@% Tech from losing if your partner wins a combat in Double Up.

traits.name: Arbiter
traits.description: Scribe a unique divine law, allowing you to choose an effect to apply to Arbiters when a chosen cause occurs. (@MinUnits@) Choose a cause and effect for your law (@MinUnits@) Effects are stronger.

traits.name: Bastion
traits.description: Your team gains @TeamwideResists@ Armor and Magic Resist. Bastions gain more, and the value doubles in the first @Duration@ seconds of combat. (@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% (@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% (@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%; Non-Bastions gain an additional @EnhancedTeamwideArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.description: Your team gains @TeamwideBonus*100@% Health. Brawlers gain more. (@MinUnits@) +@HealthBonus*100@% maximum Health

traits.name: Bulwark
traits.description: Summon a placeable relic. At the start of combat, it grants adjacent allies a @PercentHealthShield*100@% max Health shield and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

traits.name: Challenger
traits.description: Your team gains @TeamwideAS*100@% Attack Speed. Challengers gain bonus Attack Speed. When their target dies, Challengers dash to a new target and increase their Attack Speed bonus by @BurstPercent*100@% for @BurstDuration@ seconds. (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS% (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS% (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS% (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%

traits.name: Commander
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Sona gives you a random Command Mod every @RoundsPerMod@ rounds which allows you to alter the way an ally behaves during combat. Command Mods last @RoundsPerMod@ player combats even if they are not equipped.

traits.name: Conduit
traits.description: Innate: Conduits gain @InnateManaGain*100@% additional Mana from all sources. Your team gains Mana Regen, increased for Conduits. (@MinUnits@) @TeamManaRegen@ %i:TFTManaRegen% | @ChannelerManaRegen@ %i:TFTManaRegen%

traits.name: Dark Lady
traits.description: Your team gains @Durability*100@% Durability, increased to @TransformedDurability*100@% when Morgana is in her Dark Form.

traits.name: Dark Star
traits.description: (@MinUnits@) Dark Stars create a black hole that consumes enemies at @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT17_Augment_DarkStar_NeutronStar_BonusExecutePercent*100@%@ExecuteHPPercent*100@% max health. (@MinUnits@) AND they gain @ADAP@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%. (@MinUnits@) AND the strongest Dark Star unit goes supermassive, gaining @SupermassivePercentBonus*100@% effectiveness from Dark Star, and creates 2 minor Black Holes. (@MinUnits@) All Dark Stars are supermassive. At level 10, CONSUME EVERYONE.
